## Decide What the Candidate Is Ready For

Advance the candidate to a more realistic test, keep it at the current stage,
or reject it.

Record the evaluation plan, scenario coverage, collected evidence, failure
tests, and decision.
:::

::: {.callout-lab}
## Find Where Replay Stops Matching Reality

Create disagreement between offline and closed-loop results. Explain why replay
no longer supports the claim, inject a failure, and decide what test should come
next.
:::
